description: Source code defining a Python client class for interacting with Eclipse Ditto API, including methods for managing features, alerts, KPIs, and subscribers, with support for in-memory fallback.

classes.name: DittoError
classes.description: Custom exception class for Ditto operation failures.

classes.name: DittoClient
classes.description: Client class encapsulating interactions with Eclipse Ditto API, managing features, alerts, KPIs, and sessions with optional in-memory support.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _build_headers(self)
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers for requests, including authorization based on settings.

methods.name: str _thing_url(self, thing_id: str)
methods.description: Generates URL for a specific thing based on its ID.

methods.name: str _feature_url(self, thing_id: str, feature_id: str)
methods.description: Generates URL for a specific feature of a thing.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _get_or_init_mem_thing(self, thing_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes in-memory storage for a specific thing.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _get_or_init_mem_feature(self, thing_id: str, feature_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes in-memory feature storage for a thing.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_feature(self, thing_id: str, feature_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a feature for a thing, using in-memory store or REST API.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] put_feature(self, thing_id: str, feature_id: str, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates or replaces a feature for a thing, using in-memory store or REST API.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] patch_feature(self, thing_id: str, feature_id: str, patch_ops: Any)
methods.description: Applies JSON Patch operations to a feature, with fallback to read-modify-write.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] ensure_alerts_feature(self, bng_thing_id: str)
methods.description: Ensures the 'alerts' feature exists with proper default structure.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] append_alert(self, bng_thing_id: str, alert: str)
methods.description: Appends an alert string to the 'alerts' feature.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] append_recommendation(self, bng_thing_id: str, rec: str)
methods.description: Appends a recommendation string to the 'alerts' feature.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_bng_kpis(self, bng_thing_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves BNG KPI metrics from the 'state' feature.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] update_bng_kpis( self, bng_thing_id: str, cpu: Optional[int] = None, mem_pct: Optional[int] = None, active_sessions: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Updates BNG KPI metrics within the 'state' feature.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] set_subscriber_session( self, subscriber_thing_id: str, status: str, ip_address: str = "", last_allocated_at: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Updates or sets subscriber session properties.

methods.name: Dict[str,Dict[str,Any]] list_active_subscribers(self)
methods.description: Returns a mapping of active subscriber IDs to their session properties.

methods.name: None ensure_thing_exists(self, thing_id: str)
methods.description: Ensures a thing exists in in-memory mode.
